description: This source file defines the 'Cells' class, representing a collection of cell objects within a table row in the MigraDoc document object model. It includes methods for cloning, accessing individual cells, resizing the collection, serialization, and retrieving the parent table and row references.

classes.name: Cells
classes.description: Represents a collection of all cells within a table row, providing access, cloning, resizing, and serialization functionalities.

classes.name: Cells.CellsValues
classes.description: Contains internal nullable property values for the 'Cells' class, used for managing internal state.

methods.name: Cells()
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the 'Cells' collection.

methods.name: Cells(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Initializes a new 'Cells' collection with a specified parent object.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the 'Cells' collection.

methods.name: ResetCachedValues()
methods.description: Resets cached internal values within the collection.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Provides indexed access to a cell at the specified index, resizing the collection if necessary.

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes the collection into DDL using the provided serializer.
